programs.title: NITV News Update
programs.desc: NITV News recaptures the highlights of Indigenous news around the country.

programs.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo
programs.desc: Ernie meets a sculptor creating wildlife out of scrap metal and gets a tour of the region with a passionate local. Rae cruises the Clarence River with a Yaegl artist to learn how it inspires her work.

programs.title: Mad Max Beyond The Thunderdome
programs.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

programs.title: Unstaged: Archie Roach
programs.desc: Covers the electric world of freestyle dance as Maggie 'Madfox' Chen and Daisuke 'Dai' Benson prepare for City Sessions at the Sidney Myer Music Bowl.

programs.title: On Country Kitchen
programs.desc: Mark and Derek visit a chicken farm with a view, take in an afternoon of fishing together and learn about the methode traditionelle of sparkling winemaking. Mark takes Derek sightseeing.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam and guests Carol Ferrone and Mike Bennie are in The Cook Up kitchen and keen for food that can be made in 15 minutes flat.
